'''B3-T4''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] with [[Color/Legends|blue]] and white plating. Active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="CWA" /> it was built by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] like all [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. B3-T4 stood at 0.96 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="NEGTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
B3-T4 first appeared as a purchasable companion for players in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] released by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment in [[2010]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was gifted to all players who participated in the game's beta, hence its name spelling out the word beta.
